name: Saves
summary: Save slots, autosave and the versioned save file; quest progress travels inside the save.

options.name: Synced with the server
options.doc: Offline and server copies reconciled three-way, with play access (catalog saves-conflict-resolution, saves-player-identity-play-access).

parameters.doc: How many manual slots the save/load panel shows; today the template token {{MAX_SAVE_SLOTS}}.
Seconds between autosaves; 0 turns autosave off.
Show the indicator while an autosave is written.

extensionPoints.signature: ExtensionContract {owner, describe, defaultValue, migrate?} in extensionRegistry (save-extensions.ts)
extensionPoints.doc: Another system's state that rides in currentState.extensions and migrates with the file.

assistant.summary: The save file format, its migrations and the slot messages are core's; the binding writes, reads and shows slots.
notes: Change the slot count or the autosave interval with the parameters, not code.
A new system's state goes into the save as a registered save extension (extensionRegistry), never as a new top-level field.
Raise game_saved after a completed write and game_loaded after a read and migration, built with gameSavedEvent / gameLoadedEvent.
doNot: Change SaveFile or SAVE_FILE_VERSION in engine code: the format and its migrations live in core.
Write your own corrupted-slot messages: SLOT_MESSAGES is the shared copy.
